note: The one list of every strategy and its stage. Edit it by a reviewed pull request. It holds no live figures: names, stage, rules in plain words, dates, and an n only when it comes from public data (nBasis says which).

strategies.name: Gold closing buy
strategies.rule: Gold: the favourite side at 88c to 97c, about 6 minutes before the close
strategies.kill: Gold kill latch: off for good at a drawdown of $58.75 from its own peak, or net under -$20 after 40 trades; only a reviewed edit re-arms it
strategies.return: Shadow profit factor 1.3+ over at least 60 trades and 7 days, second half 1.3+, then a reviewed re-arm at half size for the first 30 trades (GOLDOFF supplies the record)

strategies.name: Open interest jump
strategies.rule: Bitcoin: the cheaper side at 5c to 50c after an open interest jump, held to settlement
strategies.nextReadText: Forward read date in the bot's registry
strategies.kill: Its own drawdown stop, 24 losses in a row, or net under -$6 after 40 fills, plus the shared 12% stop and 5.5% window cap; never re-armed automatically
strategies.return: None of its own: the general lifecycle (14 day cool-off, a fresh shadow run of 100 to 150 fills at cash PF 1.3+, second half 1.2+, owner approval)
notes: Probe since Oct 30, held to settlement; not at the research bar. Thin sample: most price-band cells read no evidence at their n

strategies.name: Release day longshot
strategies.rule: Release mornings: the cheaper side at 5c to 50c in the 8:30 window, held to settlement
strategies.nextReadText: Forward read date in the bot's registry
strategies.kill: Code: net below $0 after 40 fills, or 20 losses in a row. The owner's profit factor line of 1.2 is not in code and is read by hand at the Dec 7 interim read
strategies.return: None of its own: the general lifecycle (14 day cool-off, fresh shadow run, owner approval)
notes: Probe, 8 series at the 8:30 ET release windows; too few fills to read a profit factor

strategies.name: Gold return record
strategies.rule: Logs gold's own entry (the favourite side at 88c to 97c, 330 to 400 seconds left) whether or not gold is latched off, so gold's return rule can be checked
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Earliest return review: 7 days after the first row, and only once 60 settled rows exist
strategies.nBasis: Shadow rows the bot logs from public quotes; the count is shown from the private log, not stored here
strategies.kill: Log only, no order. Nothing to kill; it is the return evidence for gold
strategies.return: Gold may return only at shadow profit factor 1.3+ over at least 60 trades and 7 days, second half 1.3+, then a reviewed re-arm at half size
notes: to confirm with the Head of R&D: first-row date (set from the registration date, not the first logged row)
strategies.roomWhat: trades toward the 60 the return rule needs

strategies.name: Approval NO side
strategies.rule: Approval markets, one day before the close, +1c, hold: arm A buys NO paid 0.75 to 0.90, arm B buys NO paid 0.10 to 0.25, 3 contracts
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: First read when each arm has 30 paper fills; graduation to a live probe needs PF 1.3+ over 100 paper fills in 2 of 3 windows (owner rule)
strategies.nBasis: Development paper observations, pooled and partial, public candles: no evidence, leans against
strategies.kill: 20 paper fills with net under -$15, or 5 losses in a row (stop recording that arm)
strategies.return: A 14 day cool-off, shadow PF 1.3+ at +1c on 30+ fills, owner approval
strategies.roomWhat: paper fills toward the first read, per arm

strategies.name: Spot lead
strategies.rule: Bitcoin and Ethereum 15 minute markets priced from Coinbase one minute candles; a forward record only. Cannot go live as registered (the Coinbase signal needs the owner's popup naming the venue)
strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Re-read once, about Nov 21 to 23, on unseen windows closing after 2026-11-11T16:00Z. Bar: pooled PF 1.3+ at +1c with a 2 second delay on 80+ firings, both halves above 1.0, above 1.0 at +10 seconds
strategies.nBasis: Development read of public candle data; labelled no evidence at n while under 80 firings
strategies.kill: FAIL if pooled PF is under 1.0 at +0c; DATA_LIMITED if above 1.0 but the bar is not met or n is under 80
strategies.return: None (no money). A single re-read on the unseen block

strategies.name: Perp-model longshot
strategies.rule: Bitcoin: once, 2 minutes before the close, the cheaper side at 5c to 30c when a model on the price of Bitcoin's perpetual says it is worth at least 5c more than its price, held to settlement
strategies.nextReadText: Held-out read of the research rule, once, on or after 2026-11-20. Probation fills are not research evidence
strategies.kill: Code: net under -$18 after 5 settled fills, or 30 losses in a row, plus the shared 12% stop and 5.5% window cap; never re-armed automatically
strategies.return: None of its own: a reviewed edit and the owner's approval (the general lifecycle: 14 day cool-off, fresh shadow run at the shadow bar)
notes: Probation seat, 3 contracts, shares Bitcoin with OICORE on the same side only; no evidence of an edge at the research bar, a thin development read only
The earlier Bitcoin lead and lag variants (spot version, book version) are folded in here: they stay only as lines in the Nov 20 sitting

strategies.name: Combo house side

strategies.label: UNPROVEN
strategies.nextReadText: Development read on or after Nov 26; held-out on or after Dec 12, only if development met the bar
strategies.nBasis: Public combo quotes recorded to the combo-data branch
strategies.kill: Paper net under -$40 at $2 a fill, or PF under 1.2 on the first 100 settled
strategies.return: The politics rulebook's: a 14 day cool-off, shadow PF 1.3+, owner approval
